text: Ko Allah woni waɗanɗo on, onon yimɓe ɓen, ndii leydi, dunngal ñiiɓirgal mon, O waɗi kammu ngun, ñeñaangu dow mon, hara yanataa e mon, O mbaadini on ka renngaaji yumma mon'en - O moƴƴini mbaadiiji mon, - O arsiki on laaɓuɗi dagiiɗi. Ko On mooɗon, neeminirɗo on ɗum, woni Allah Joomi mon. Senaare heewii e Jeyɗo tageefo ngon fow. Reweteeɗo alanaa ngo, si wanaa Kanko seniiɗo On.
